h1: Four launches, no earned demand leader
room_line: Ask what survives context exclusions, not what looked loud online.
coming_kick: Horror presents two distinct mechanisms: broad youth trial versus localized Banjar affinity.
coming_caveat: Four domestic October 22 releases. Planning assumes they play under owner policy and usual filters; booking and DCP remain unconfirmed. Publicity is not paid demand.
signal_note: Public samples describe different signal shapes and are shown side by side, not converted into cross-title ratios. Evidence was collected during the Sunday morning run and retained by 09:47 WIB; the 09:00:02 bundle stamp identifies run start, not a pre-09:00 evidence cutoff. No later research refresh is included.

eligibility.basis: Planning may proceed under the owner-authorized working assumption that current domestic releases play, subject to the usual exclusions and any contrary private facts. Booking and DCP availability remain unconfirmed. Production-house identity is source-captured separately and is not booking evidence.

coming.meta: Raihaanun, Baim Wong and Dapur Film: Hanung Bramantyo produces; Nikita Mirzani is executive producer.
coming.logline: A single mother rebuilding her life through acting confronts sexual harassment, public slander and a custody struggle after leaving a toxic marriage.
coming.quality: Quality remains unproven: one special-screening attendee reported strong personal resonance, but captured coverage supplies no independent review of the completed film.
coming.gold: Clear but narrow adult-drama proposition: recognizable actors carry a topical story about KDRT, single motherhood and recovery, with stronger relevance than escapist breadth.
coming.promo: Active issue-led campaign: an Epicentrum XXI gala, cast-and-creator attendance, a symbolic trauma installation and regional special screenings support launch visibility.
coming.social: Visible but spillover-heavy social attention: several title-linked TikToks reached 54,423–253,552 views, while the Instagram sample was largely unrelated to this film.
coming.demand: Paid demand is still unknown: screenings and a nationwide release date are documented, but no captured full-text source provides presales, ordinary ticket sales or seat-fill evidence.
coming.risk: Audience-breadth risk: the 17+ rating, heavy abuse-and-trauma material and an unproven feature debut may constrain casual demand despite recognizable talent.
coming.bet: If SAMS confirms eligibility, day-1 median ordinary paid ADM/show will reach 6 but stay below 15, and remain at least 6 on day 4.
coming.nug: Its edge is an issue-led single-mother recovery story amplified by recognizable talent; TikTok reach is real but often celebrity-led.

lanes.read: A single mother rebuilding her life through acting confronts sexual harassment, public slander and a custody struggle after leaving a toxic marriage.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured full-text coverage consistently describes Niken rebuilding her life and fighting to recover her dignity, voice and children.
lanes.decision_consequence: Position it as an adult recovery-and-resistance drama, not a conventional romance or broad family film.

lanes.read: Raihaanun and Baim Wong lead; Hanung Bramantyo produces, Nikita Mirzani is executive producer, and Dapur Film is the production house.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Multiple captured full-text sources identify the principal cast, producer roles and Dapur Film directly.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use Raihaanun, Baim Wong and Hanung Bramantyo as the credible talent anchors; do not leave the production house classified as unknown.

lanes.read: Quality remains unproven: one special-screening attendee reported strong personal resonance, but captured coverage supplies no independent review of the completed film.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A Jogja screening attendee connected Niken's story to the courage of her own single mother, indicating possible emotional resonance in the target audience.
lanes.missing_fact: An independent review or a sufficiently broad post-screening audience sample assessing the completed film's execution.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not award a quality premium; treat emotional resonance as a promising but isolated adjacent signal.

lanes.read: Clear but narrow adult-drama proposition: recognizable actors carry a topical story about KDRT, single motherhood and recovery, with stronger relevance than escapist breadth.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The film combines recognizable Indonesian talent with a 17+ issue-led story centered on trauma, divorce, sexual harassment and maternal resilience.
lanes.decision_consequence: Target adults drawn to socially resonant drama; avoid assuming broad family or youth appeal from cast visibility alone.

lanes.read: Active issue-led campaign: an Epicentrum XXI gala, cast-and-creator attendance, a symbolic trauma installation and regional special screenings support launch visibility.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured reports document the gala premiere, complete principal attendance, a butterfly installation built around anonymous trauma reflections and a Jogja screening.
lanes.decision_consequence: Credit the title with organized launch activity, while keeping campaign execution separate from film quality or paid demand.

lanes.read: Visible but spillover-heavy social attention: several title-linked TikToks reached 54,423–253,552 views, while the Instagram sample was largely unrelated to this film.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured TikTok sample contains high-view posts tied to the film, Nikita Mirzani and her family, but the Instagram keyword sample is dominated by unrelated works sharing the title.
lanes.decision_consequence: Count pockets of awareness, not broad film-specific engagement or ticket intent; much of the strongest reach may belong to celebrity narrative spillover.

lanes.read: Paid demand is still unknown: screenings and a nationwide release date are documented, but no captured full-text source provides presales, ordinary ticket sales or seat-fill evidence.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A regional special screening occurred and the 22 October release was promoted, but the readable coverage reports no transactional result.
lanes.missing_fact: Current ordinary-session presales, paid admissions or verified seat occupancy for the theatrical opening.
lanes.decision_consequence: Assign no demand uplift and no exploration floor until SAMS eligibility is confirmed and purchase-proximity evidence appears.

lanes.read: Audience-breadth risk: the 17+ rating, heavy abuse-and-trauma material and an unproven feature debut may constrain casual demand despite recognizable talent.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured coverage identifies a 17+ classification, difficult KDRT and sexual-harassment themes, and Dmaz Brodjonegoro's feature-directing debut.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep any eventual opening test conservative and monitor ordinary paid performance rather than protecting shows on topical importance or celebrity awareness.

ai_rating.source_confidence: High for identity, story and campaign; low for completed-film quality and paid demand.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: Unresolved: M-Tix lists it in-window, but no sealed SAMS match or current Programming confirmation exists.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Near release, with special screenings documented; no ordinary presales, paid admissions or verified seat fill.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Organized launch and TikToks up to 253,552 views; Instagram is polluted and reach may be celebrity spillover.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: 17+ abuse-and-trauma drama plus an unproven feature debut may limit casual breadth; quality remains unreviewed.
ai_rating.actionability: Observe and learn only: confirm SAMS eligibility and obtain ordinary-session purchase evidence.

coming.meta: Ochi Rosdiana, Jeff Smith and Lab Pictures: with Yessica Tamara, Alif Rivelino and Chelcy Clarissa; directed by Adhe Dharmastriya.
coming.logline: Young horror-content creators enter a forbidden room in an old Malioboro motel, play a Lingsir Wengi recording and awaken a vengeful spirit that exposes fractures in their friendship.
coming.quality: Unproven current-film quality: promotional material promises tense supernatural horror mixed with friendship, betrayal and emotional stakes, but no readable independent review or ordinary-audience assessment was captured.
coming.gold: Clear youth-horror proposition: the Lingsir Wengi motif is fused with creator-era ambition, friendship and betrayal, giving the campaign an accessible group-viewing hook; conversion beyond discounted activity remains unproven.
coming.promo: Active conversion campaign: captured posts show special screenings, cast appearances, signing sessions and buy-one-get-one-free ticket (BOGOF) activity across several cities, supported by an earlier official poster-and-trailer launch.
coming.social: Visible but campaign-led reach: one sampled TikTok post reached 113,369 views and 4,033 likes, while most other posts were materially smaller and comments or shares remained modest; this is directional awareness, not representative demand.
coming.demand: Insufficient evidence of ordinary paid demand: campaign posts claim Mall BTM was full and Mega Bekasi nearly full, but the bundle contains no direct ticketing receipt, seat denominator or separation from BOGOF and special-screening effects.
coming.risk: False-positive risk: strong campaign volume, one high-reach post and promoted venue scarcity could be mistaken for organic demand; private SAMS eligibility is also unverified, so the room should not convert public activity into a local booking assumption.
coming.bet: If SAMS plays it, ordinary ADM/show will clear its domestic-horror baseline by Day 4 after BOGOF and events are excluded.
coming.nug: A familiar Lingsir Wengi motif recast around young creators chasing virality gives the film a clean, contemporary youth-horror hook.

lanes.read: A group of young horror-content creators enters a forbidden room in an old Malioboro motel, plays a recording of Lingsir Wengi and awakens a vengeful spirit that exposes fractures in their friendship.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The fetched Film Indonesia synopsis directly describes the creators, forbidden room, recording and awakened spirit.
lanes.decision_consequence: The room can treat this as a clearly packaged supernatural youth-horror premise rather than an undefined genre release.

lanes.read: Commercial cast anchor: Ochi Rosdiana and Jeff Smith lead alongside Yessica Tamara, Alif Rivelino and Chelcy Clarissa; a fetched current article directly identifies Lab Pictures as the production house.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Berita Kebumen names Lab Pictures, director Adhe Dharmastriya and the principal cast in full text.
lanes.decision_consequence: Correct the prior production-house field to Lab Pictures, while making no unsupported connection to Rapi Films or any company inferred from individual producers.

lanes.read: Unproven current-film quality: promotional material promises tense supernatural horror mixed with friendship, betrayal and emotional stakes, but no readable independent review or ordinary-audience assessment was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The fetched Bens Radio feature describes the intended atmosphere and themes through filmmakers' promotional statements.
lanes.missing_fact: An independent critic review, verified screening assessment or substantive ordinary-audience reaction addressing execution rather than premise.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use the material only to describe intended feel; do not award a quality uplift or treat the gala and trailer launch as evidence that the film works.

lanes.read: Clear youth-horror proposition: the Lingsir Wengi motif is fused with creator-era ambition, friendship and betrayal, giving the campaign an accessible group-viewing hook; conversion beyond discounted activity remains unproven.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The verified premise centers on young horror creators chasing virality, while captured social posts repeatedly invite viewers to attend with friends or partners.
lanes.decision_consequence: The room should recognize a marketable concept but require ordinary paid performance before translating that concept into confidence about sustained demand.

lanes.read: Active conversion campaign: captured posts show special screenings, cast appearances, signing sessions and buy-one-get-one-free ticket (BOGOF) activity across several cities, supported by an earlier official poster-and-trailer launch.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The social sample records Depok, Bogor and Purwokerto activations, advance-ticket messaging and repeated BOGOF promotion.
lanes.decision_consequence: Expect meaningful campaign assistance around opening, but isolate promoted, discounted and special-screening results from ordinary-demand evaluation.

lanes.read: Visible but campaign-led reach: one sampled TikTok post reached 113,369 views and 4,033 likes, while most other posts were materially smaller and comments or shares remained modest; this is directional awareness, not representative demand.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The ten-post sample ranges from 350 to 113,369 views, with promotional language dominating the captured content.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat the standout post as evidence that the campaign can create reach, while withholding any organic-intent or broad-engagement premium.

lanes.read: Insufficient evidence of ordinary paid demand: campaign posts claim Mall BTM was full and Mega Bekasi nearly full, but the bundle contains no direct ticketing receipt, seat denominator or separation from BOGOF and special-screening effects.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A captured promotional post reports scarcity at two venues, while several neighboring posts advertise BOGOF offers and special screenings.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified site-level paid bookings, occupancy or admissions for ordinary shows, separated from BOGOF, complimentary seats and event screenings, plus explicit current SAMS eligibility.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not assign an exploration floor or demand uplift until Programming confirms SAMS eligibility and ordinary paid performance becomes observable.

lanes.read: False-positive risk: strong campaign volume, one high-reach post and promoted venue scarcity could be mistaken for organic demand; private SAMS eligibility is also unverified, so the room should not convert public activity into a local booking assumption.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured stream is promotion-heavy, repeatedly uses BOGOF and supplies no independent local paid-demand denominator.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title at insufficient evidence for local action, confirm eligibility first and judge any opening result only after promotional contexts are isolated.

ai_rating.source_confidence: Premise, cast, Lab Pictures and campaign activity are sourced; independent execution assessment is absent.
ai_rating.sams_relevance: M-Tix lists the release, but current private SAMS eligibility is not confirmed.
ai_rating.demand_proximity: Venue scarcity is claimed without paid-seat denominators or separation from BOGOF and special screenings.
ai_rating.promo_social_strength: Active city activations and BOGOF support; the leading sampled TikTok reached 113,369 views.
ai_rating.risk_pressure: High false-positive risk: campaign reach and promoted scarcity may overstate ordinary local demand.
ai_rating.actionability: Confirm SAMS eligibility, then observe ordinary paid performance separately from BOGOF and event activity.

coming.meta: Aulia Sarah; Pichouse Films, Pentana Production Studio and Bimasakti Pictures: with Bucek Depp and Yoriko Angeline.
coming.logline: A mistreated Banjar wife turns to forbidden black magic to control her husband, unleashing supernatural consequences that threaten her village.
coming.quality: Current-film quality remains unknown: period Banjar atmosphere, regional locations and prosthetic work indicate a distinctive intended feel, but no captured review evaluates execution.
coming.gold: Localized Banjar horror is the clearest hook: the film differentiates itself through South Kalimantan folklore, but the evidence does not establish broad-market conversion.
coming.promo: Active launch campaign: a Jakarta gala premiere, cast-attended advance screenings and a TikTok post advertising BUY 1 GET 1 are visible, but campaign activity is not ticket demand.
coming.social: Visible but uneven social traction: one explicit Pirunduk post reached 56,292 views, while another drew 23,381 views, 94 comments and 1,610 shares; the sample is directional, not representative.
coming.demand: Purchase demand remains unknown: social posts show exposure and interaction, but no captured presales, seat maps, sell-outs, ticket counts or verified SAMS booking establish conversion.
coming.risk: Conversion risk is high: promotional activity and regional distinctiveness could be mistaken for audience pull while quality, purchase proximity and private SAMS eligibility remain unresolved.
coming.bet: If Banjar-localized horror creates genuine pull, confirmed SAMS play will reach at least 6 ordinary paid ADM/show on days 1 and 4.
coming.nug: Banjar black magic, South Kalimantan locations and jukung imagery give the film a culturally specific horror identity.

lanes.read: A mistreated Banjar wife turns to forbidden black magic to control her husband, unleashing supernatural consequences that threaten her village.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Film Indonesia’s captured synopsis directly describes Siti’s abusive marriage, use of Pirunduk magic and the resulting danger.
lanes.decision_consequence: Position it as culturally specific supernatural horror, while keeping story appeal separate from demand evidence.

lanes.read: Aulia Sarah leads with Bucek Depp and Yoriko Angeline; the stronger captured production credit names Pichouse Films, Pentana Production Studio and Bimasakti Pictures.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Current gala-premiere coverage identifies the principal cast and explicitly lists the three production houses.
lanes.decision_consequence: Replace the unknown production-house field with these captured credits; do not infer Rapi Films or treat MD Pictures as settled.

lanes.read: Current-film quality remains unknown: period Banjar atmosphere, regional locations and prosthetic work indicate a distinctive intended feel, but no captured review evaluates execution.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Gala coverage describes the 1980s Banjar setting, jukung imagery, physical performance and prosthetic makeup.
lanes.missing_fact: An independent review, screening assessment or attributable audience reaction to the completed film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Give no quality premium; present the regional texture as a creative proposition requiring post-screening validation.

lanes.read: Localized Banjar horror is the clearest hook: the film differentiates itself through South Kalimantan folklore, but the evidence does not establish broad-market conversion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured sources consistently describe Pirunduk as locally rooted Banjar black magic rather than generic supernatural horror.
lanes.decision_consequence: Market the regional folklore distinction, but do not translate thematic differentiation into a larger opening allocation.

lanes.read: Active launch campaign: a Jakarta gala premiere, cast-attended advance screenings and a TikTok post advertising BUY 1 GET 1 are visible, but campaign activity is not ticket demand.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured gala coverage and title-bound social posts show coordinated activity immediately before the 22 October release.
lanes.decision_consequence: Acknowledge meaningful campaign support without adding an allocation premium until sales or attendance verifies conversion.

lanes.read: Visible but uneven social traction: one explicit Pirunduk post reached 56,292 views, while another drew 23,381 views, 94 comments and 1,610 shares; the sample is directional, not representative.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured ten-post TikTok sample contains two clearly title-bound posts with material reach or sharing.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat social as an awareness and engagement clue, not as proof of purchase intent or nationwide demand.

lanes.read: Purchase demand remains unknown: social posts show exposure and interaction, but no captured presales, seat maps, sell-outs, ticket counts or verified SAMS booking establish conversion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The strongest adjacent signal is a title-bound TikTok post with 23,381 views and 1,610 shares, which still does not measure ticket purchases.
lanes.missing_fact: Verified advance sales or seat movement, plus explicit current SAMS eligibility or booking confirmation.
lanes.decision_consequence: Assign no demand uplift or exploration floor until Programming confirms eligibility and purchase-proximate evidence appears.

lanes.read: Conversion risk is high: promotional activity and regional distinctiveness could be mistaken for audience pull while quality, purchase proximity and private SAMS eligibility remain unresolved.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The bundle captures campaign activity and creative positioning but no independent quality verdict or usable purchase evidence.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the room at insufficient evidence and require current Programming confirmation before considering any allocation.

coming.meta: Satine Zaneta, Bahagia Tanpa Drama and Viddsee: with Ciccio Manassero, Ajil Ditto, Shania Gracia, Nugie and Kimberly Ryder in an Indonesia-Singapore co-production.
coming.logline: A struggling young woman supporting her family becomes a low-powered vampire and must choose between elite privilege and protecting her threatened apartment community.
coming.quality: Quality remains unproven: no independent review or post-screening audience assessment was captured; the strongest adjacent evidence is a 104-minute, 13+ drama-comedy built around social-class satire.
coming.gold: Clear youth-facing differentiator: an urban vampire drama-comedy turns class inequality, economic pressure and a daughter supporting her family into a relatable hook; distinctiveness is credible, but conversion is unproven.
coming.promo: Active launch campaign: an official trailer-and-poster event and a 16 October gala produced fresh social clips; this proves coordinated promotional activity, not audience quality or ticket conversion.
coming.social: Small but uneven social response: nine of ten captured TikToks stayed below 4,100 views, while one cast-related gala clip reached 7,189 views and 692 likes; this is directional interest, not broad demand.
coming.demand: Demand remains unproven: the official trailer has no captured views, likes or comments, social activity is mainly gala or cast-led, and no validated presale, seat-map or purchase-intent evidence was captured.
coming.risk: Demand and quality remain unproven despite a confirmed national release and active campaign. Planning assumes playability under owner policy; private booking and DCP status remain unconfirmed.
coming.bet: If SAMS confirms eligibility, weighted ordinary paid ADM/show will stay below 10 on day 1 and through day 4.
coming.nug: A local-vampire class satire gives it a distinctive youth hook; the lone social spike is cast-led, not title-level intent.

lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Film Indonesia’s captured synopsis directly establishes Siti’s transformation, economic hardship and final conflict.
lanes.decision_consequence: The room can position it as an accessible class-satire comedy with a clear emotional choice, rather than conventional vampire horror.

lanes.read: Satine Zaneta leads with Ciccio Manassero, Ajil Ditto, Shania Gracia, Nugie and Kimberly Ryder; the core production houses are Bahagia Tanpa Drama and Viddsee.

lanes.read: Quality remains unproven: no independent review or post-screening audience assessment was captured; the strongest adjacent evidence is a 104-minute, 13+ drama-comedy built around social-class satire.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF verifies the film’s format, classification and drama-comedy identity, but provides no independent evaluation of execution.
lanes.missing_fact: An independent full-film review or attributable post-screening audience assessment of the finished film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not upgrade the film on premise or campaign polish; preserve flexibility until finished-film reactions or ordinary admissions reveal execution quality.

lanes.read: Clear youth-facing differentiator: an urban vampire drama-comedy turns class inequality, economic pressure and a daughter supporting her family into a relatable hook; distinctiveness is credible, but conversion is unproven.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Fetched coverage consistently describes an unusual local-vampire premise tied to economic pressure, youth concerns and family responsibility.
lanes.decision_consequence: If eligibility is confirmed, test the title as a differentiated youth comedy rather than granting a wide floor based on genre familiarity.

lanes.read: Active launch campaign: an official trailer-and-poster event and a 16 October gala produced fresh social clips; this proves coordinated promotional activity, not audience quality or ticket conversion.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The fetched trailer-launch report and captured TikTok sample document current campaign activity around the official trailer and gala premiere.
lanes.decision_consequence: Acknowledge useful campaign support, but require purchase or admissions evidence before translating it into additional shows.

lanes.read: Small but uneven social response: nine of ten captured TikToks stayed below 4,100 views, while one cast-related gala clip reached 7,189 views and 692 likes; this is directional interest, not broad demand.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The ten-post TikTok sample shows one comparatively strong cast clip amid mostly low-reach gala and campaign posts.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat the isolated spike as talent-led attention and monitor whether it spreads into title-level intent before increasing exposure.

lanes.read: Demand remains unproven: the official trailer has no captured views, likes or comments, social activity is mainly gala or cast-led, and no validated presale, seat-map or purchase-intent evidence was captured.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The official trailer asset is verified, but all reach and engagement metrics are null; the TikTok sample shows attention without a purchasing signal.
lanes.missing_fact: Validated presales, identified cinema showtimes with seat movement, ticket-intent comments or ordinary paid admissions.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not infer an exploration floor from public awareness; wait for confirmed SAMS eligibility and the first purchase-proximate or ordinary-performance evidence.

lanes.read: Demand and quality remain unproven despite a confirmed national release and active campaign. Planning assumes playability under owner policy; private booking and DCP status remain unconfirmed.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: LSF confirms the 22 October public premiere, but the bundle explicitly separates public intelligence from private SAMS truth and supplies no current booking confirmation.
lanes.missing_fact: Explicit current Programming confirmation of title-by-site ordinary eligibility, plus purchase-proximate or finished-film evidence.
lanes.decision_consequence: Carry the title into Wednesday planning under the disclosed owner assumption and usual filters; revise on contrary booking facts. Do not treat weak publicity as a reason to bypass the ordinary new-release policy.

what_milo_sees.title: LINGSIR WENGI - MOTEL MALIOBORO
what_milo_sees.insight: LINGSIR WENGI - MOTEL MALIOBORO has the slate's clearest opening-trial mechanism: familiar supernatural material, youth-creator framing and active conversion support. BOGOF and events can still manufacture apparent demand; clean Day 1-to-4 performance must validate it.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Can Programming identify matched SAMS locations for LINGSIR WENGI - MOTEL MALIOBORO and PIRUNDUK, and record BOGOF, complimentary and event sessions separately before opening?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: If matched locations and separate context records are feasible, preregister the existing low-confidence Day 4 comparison. Keep LINGSIR WENGI - MOTEL MALIOBORO as a test hypothesis, not a proven demand leader.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: If matched ordinary paid conditions are not feasible, withdraw the head-to-head comparison and assess each title against its own site baseline. Do not interpret promotion-led traffic as a win.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: If the room cannot establish comparable locations or context records, mark the paired test NOT_TESTABLE until those inputs exist. Carry no demand preference from the campaign.

public_signal_shape.comparison: BEAUTIFUL PAIN's leading sampled TikTok reached 253,552; the figures show awareness, not matched purchase intent.

what_milo_sees.evidence: The youth-horror hook, city activations and BOGOF support can create trial, but no paid-seat denominator separates ordinary demand from campaign effects.

what_milo_sees.title: PIRUNDUK
what_milo_sees.insight: PIRUNDUK owns the most culturally specific affinity cue: Banjar black magic, South Kalimantan locations and 1,610 shares. That may produce concentrated pull, but geographic relevance and purchase conversion remain unresolved.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Which SAMS locations, if any, have evidenced audience affinity relevant to PIRUNDUK's Banjar or South Kalimantan identity? What local evidence supports that judgment?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: If Programming supplies attributable local audience evidence, record a site-specific affinity hypothesis and test the existing 6 ordinary paid ADM/show prediction on Day 1 and Day 4.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: If no local evidence supports relevance, drop the geographic preference and evaluate PIRUNDUK as an unproven horror proposition. Do not turn sampled shares into a site-demand claim.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: If local relevance remains unknown, record the missing audience evidence and retain no geographic preference. The existing performance hypothesis remains a low-confidence test.

public_signal_shape.comparison: The sampled post also recorded 23,381 views; shares indicate engagement, but no matched denominator establishes superior conversion.

what_milo_sees.evidence: Its regional identity is more distinctive than generic horror positioning, while uneven traction, promotional support and absent paid evidence keep confidence low.

what_milo_sees.title: BEAUTIFUL PAIN
what_milo_sees.insight: BEAUTIFUL PAIN has the largest stated sampled TikTok spike, but celebrity spillover can overstate title intent. SITI SI VAMPIR shows weaker distributed social response yet a distinctive youth-class premise; neither pattern establishes paid demand.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Does Programming have ordinary paid booking evidence for BEAUTIFUL PAIN or SITI SI VAMPIR that is independent of cast-led posts, promotions and special screenings?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: If one title has verified ordinary paid evidence, record it as the stronger evidence case and identify its sites and denominator; keep the later outcome tests separate.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: If neither title has ordinary paid evidence, remove any buyer-preference claim based on TikTok reach. Preserve their different audience propositions without declaring a demand winner.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: If the evidence or traffic context cannot be verified, carry no demand preference between BEAUTIFUL PAIN and SITI SI VAMPIR and name the missing input.

public_signal_shape.comparison: SITI SI VAMPIR had nine of ten sampled TikToks below 4,100 views; these unequal sample shapes are not treated as a ratio.

what_milo_sees.evidence: BEAUTIFUL PAIN combines topical material and recognizable talent with the slate's largest stated reach spike, but has no ordinary purchase evidence. SITI SI VAMPIR's response is mostly small and event-led.

title_hypotheses.title: BEAUTIFUL PAIN
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If SAMS confirms eligibility and books the film, issue-led awareness should produce a watchable but non-breakout opening: median ordinary paid ADM/show of at least 6 but below 15 on day 1.
title_hypotheses.evidence: The topical adult story, recognizable talent, organized launch and film-linked TikTok reach create plausible awareness, while absent presales and independent quality evidence cap expectations.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: Day-1 median below 6 or at least 15, or a day-4 median below 6, would reject the proposed moderate-opening-and-hold pattern.

measurement.comparison: Test whether median ordinary paid ADM/show is 6–<15 on day 1 and remains ≥6 on day 4, excluding support, event, nobar, fixed and other non-ordinary sessions.

title_hypotheses.title: LINGSIR WENGI - MOTEL MALIOBORO
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If programmed at SAMS, the clear youth-horror hook and active conversion campaign will generate viable opening trial, but sustained ordinary demand will be weaker than campaign reach suggests once BOGOF and event activity are removed.
title_hypotheses.evidence: The youth-horror premise and active conversion campaign can generate opening trial, but campaign-led reach does not establish sustained ordinary paid demand.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if most eligible sites fail to clear their comparable domestic-horror baseline by Day 4 after BOGOF, special-screening and complimentary activity is excluded.

measurement.comparison: Compare ordinary paid ADM/show with each eligible site's recent domestic-horror baseline, excluding BOGOF, complimentary seats and special screenings.

title_hypotheses.title: PIRUNDUK
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If Banjar-localized horror and the active launch campaign create genuine pull, confirmed SAMS play should achieve at least 6 ordinary paid admissions per show on day 1 and remain at or above 6 on day 4.
title_hypotheses.evidence: Banjar-localized positioning, active launch support and 1,610 shares create a testable awareness signal, while no purchase evidence confirms conversion.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: No SAMS site confirms eligibility, or eligible play records below 6 ordinary paid admissions per show on either day 1 or day 4 after exclusions.

measurement.comparison: No eligible site confirms play, or ordinary paid ADM/show is below 6 on either day after excluding promo, event, support, fixed and other non-ordinary contexts.

title_hypotheses.title: SITI SI VAMPIR
title_hypotheses.hypothesis: If SAMS confirms ordinary eligibility and books the film, its differentiated premise will produce niche curiosity rather than breakout demand: weighted ordinary paid admissions per show will remain below 10 on day 1 and will not reach 10 by day 4.
title_hypotheses.evidence: The relatable class-satire premise may create niche curiosity, but social response is mostly small and event-led, with no purchase-proximate evidence or independent finished-film assessment.
title_hypotheses.falsifier: Falsified if weighted ordinary paid admissions per show reach at least 10 on day 1, or rise to at least 10 by day 4 with improvement at a majority of booked sites.

measurement.comparison: Network-weighted ordinary paid ADM/show stays below 10 on day 1 and does not reach 10 by day 4; exclude promo, event, support, fixed and complimentary contexts.
